message: The ember target does not support component: Child components, slots, models, context and the built-in components are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.

The astro target does not support interactivity: Astro components render on the server only, and each render is a new instance: event handlers, template refs, watchers and lifecycle hooks never run, and state keeps its initial value.
The ember target does not support interactivity: Listeners, template refs, watchers and hooks are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.
The astro target does not support composable-effect-order: A composable's watchers, effects and hooks never run on Astro: components render on the server only, and nothing runs in the browser.
The ember target does not support composable-effect-order: Composables are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.
The ember target does not support composables: Composables are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.

The react target does not support composable-effect-order: A composable is a custom hook, and React runs a component's effects in its own order (ADR-0048): a hook's watchers, effects and hooks cannot take their place among the caller's own, so code that relies on that order may see another (ADR-0069).

The solid target does not support composable-effect-order: A composable's watchers coalesce in its own module's queue (`createWatcher`), apart from the caller's, so its watchers, effects and hooks cannot take their place among the caller's own, and code that relies on that order may see another (ADR-0069).

The solid2 target does not support composable-effect-order: A composable's watchers coalesce in its own module's queue (`createWatcher`), apart from the caller's, so its watchers, effects and hooks cannot take their place among the caller's own, and code that relies on that order may see another (ADR-0069).
